description: This file defines the implementation of the VertexBuffer class and related classes such as VertexBufferInterface, StreamingVertexBufferInterface, and StaticVertexBufferInterface. It manages graphics API-agnostic vertex buffer operations, including buffer creation, reference counting, size management, and attribute storage, specifically for Direct3D in the ANGLE project.

classes.name: VertexBuffer
classes.description: Abstract class managing reference counting, serial number, and lifecycle of vertex buffers.

classes.name: VertexBufferInterface
classes.description: Interface for managing vertex buffer operations, including size, serial, and buffer access.

classes.name: StreamingVertexBufferInterface
classes.description: Derived class for dynamic, streaming vertex buffers with space reservation and attribute storage.

classes.name: StaticVertexBufferInterface
classes.description: Derived class for static, unchanging vertex buffers with attribute matching and storage.

classes.name: AttributeSignature
classes.description: Helper class for matching and setting attribute signatures in static vertex buffers.

methods.name: updateSerial
methods.description: Updates the serial number for the vertex buffer.

methods.name: getSerial
methods.description: Returns the serial number of the vertex buffer.

methods.name: release
methods.description: Decrements reference count and deletes object if count reaches zero.

methods.name: setBufferSize
methods.description: Sets the size of the vertex buffer.

methods.name: getBufferSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the vertex buffer.

methods.name: discard
methods.description: Discards the contents of the buffer.

methods.name: storeVertexAttributes
methods.description: Stores vertex attribute data into the buffer.

methods.name: storeStaticAttribute
methods.description: Stores static attribute data into the buffer.
